nights.title: Pedro Fernández - Ave Fénix Two'r
nights.name: Pedro Fernández
nights.extract: José Martín Cuevas Cobos, known by his stage name Pedro Fernández, is a Mexican singer, songwriter, actor, and television host. Fernández began his international career as Pedrito Fernández at the age of seven. In the 1980s, he turned to be known as a scream king, thanks to his horror film starring roles in films such as Vacaciones de terror (1989), Pánico en la montaña (1989) and Trampa Infernal (1989).

nights.title: Arcángel - La 8va Maravilla World Tour
nights.name: Arcángel
nights.extract: Austin Agustín Santos, better known by his stage name Arcángel, is an American rapper and singer. He is often described as one of the most influential artists in the Latin urban genre, as well in Latin music overall, and one of the pioneers of Latin trap music. Around 2002, he became interested in becoming a performer of reggaeton. He met fellow singer De la Ghetto while living in Puerto Rico, where they eventually formed a popular then-underground reggaeton duo, Arcángel & De la Ghetto.

en.who: Austin Agustín Santos, better known by his stage name Arcángel, is an American rapper and singer. He is often described as one of the most influential artists in the Latin urban genre.
facts: He is often described as one of the most influential artists in the Latin urban genre, as well in Latin music overall, and one of the pioneers of Latin trap music.
He met fellow singer De la Ghetto while living in Puerto Rico, where they eventually formed a popular then-underground reggaeton duo, Arcángel & De la Ghetto.

de.who: Austin Agustín Santos, besser bekannt unter dem Künstlernamen Arcángel, ist ein amerikanischer Rapper und Sänger. Er wird häufig als einer der einflussreichsten Künstler des lateinamerikanischen Urban-Genres beschrieben.
facts: Er gilt als einer der einflussreichsten Künstler im lateinamerikanischen Urban-Genre und in der lateinamerikanischen Musik insgesamt sowie als einer der Pioniere des Latin Trap.
In Puerto Rico lernte er den Sänger De la Ghetto kennen; daraus entstand das damals noch im Untergrund beliebte Reggaeton-Duo Arcángel & De la Ghetto.

tr.who: Austin Agustín Santos, sahne adı arcángel ile daha çok bilinen, amerikalı bir rapçi ve şarkıcı. çoğu zaman latin urban türünün en etkili sanatçılarından biri olarak tarif ediliyor.
facts: latin urban türünde ve genel olarak latin müziğinde en etkili sanatçılardan biri olarak tarif ediliyor; latin trap'in öncülerinden biri sayılıyor.
porto riko'da yaşarken şarkıcı de la ghetto ile tanıştı; birlikte o zamanlar yeraltında popüler olan arcángel & de la ghetto reggaeton ikilisini kurdular.
